generated_by: services/api/app/rules/coverage/render_coverage_matrix.py renders COVERAGE_MATRIX.md from this file; this file is the authored data artifact (not AI-computed at runtime).
review_state_note: Nothing here is reviewed. Every cited rule is status needs_review; the highest status any cell carries is implemented_draft (D-090-R010). No rule math is asserted.

status_vocab.implemented_draft: A needs_review rule (or a surfaced conditional alternative in a needs_review rule) exists in the repo for this district x column. Never reviewed.
status_vocab.not_implemented: No rule/exception in the repo covers it and no captured source establishes non-applicability. Default for unknowns.
status_vocab.not_applicable: A captured source or an explicit product decision establishes the provision does not apply / never yields a computed number. Used only with a cited basis.
status_vocab.needs_reviewer: Classification requires a qualified reviewer's legal reading; recorded with the reason in notes.

street_width_source_vocab.dcm_mapped_width: The rule reads the DCM mapped street width (the mapped width zoning uses). When the width is unknown the engine returns both wide- and narrow-street results (plan §4; D-052).
street_width_source_vocab.unknown_then_both_results: The documented unknown-handling of a dcm_mapped_width rule: when the width is unresolved, both wide- and narrow-street results are shown side by side (plan §4).
street_width_source_vocab.not_needed: The rule does not depend on street width.
street_width_source_vocab.null: No rule exists for the cell, so there is no rule-level street-width source to declare.
